description: Tip Jar real recorded sound effects; public HQ MP3 previews adapted under their published Creative Commons licenses.

recordings.name: shoot
recordings.title: Ice Hockey Sound Library_Wrist Shot
recordings.author: AudioAlchemyDesigns
recordings.use: Isolated sweeping wrist-shot release and its short natural decay.
recordings.modifications: Excerpt 0.436–0.720s; mono downmix; 48 kHz resampling; 1 pass(es) of 75 Hz single-pole high-pass; peak level adjustment to 0.80; 0.5 ms fade-in and 60 ms fade-out; 8 ms silent end padding. No added synthesized layer or reverb.

recordings.name: tip
recordings.title: Ice Hockey Sound Library_Stick Handles
recordings.author: AudioAlchemyDesigns
recordings.use: One isolated puck-to-stick contact from a stickhandling recording.
recordings.modifications: Excerpt 0.660–0.805s; mono downmix; 48 kHz resampling; 1 pass(es) of 90 Hz single-pole high-pass; peak level adjustment to 0.72; 0.5 ms fade-in and 35 ms fade-out; 8 ms silent end padding. No added synthesized layer or reverb.

recordings.name: post
recordings.title: Ice Hockey Sound Library_Post2
recordings.author: AudioAlchemyDesigns

recordings.name: net
recordings.title: hockey net
recordings.author: Luisa_Sanchez

recordings.name: target
recordings.title: Glockenspiel - C5 (glock_medium_C5.wav)
recordings.author: sgossner
recordings.use: Real glockenspiel note by Sam Gossner / VSCO 2 Community Edition. Success-only playback rises through C-D-E-G-high C for targets cleared 1-5, independent of location or power.
